changelog: UI Polish: Fixed an issue where Live TV categories occasionally displayed as raw numbers instead of names.
Customization: Wired up the custom Focus UI colors so your selected theme highlights apply across the entire app.
Navigation: Fixed 'lost focus' bugs in Settings and DVR menus to ensure D-pad navigation always shows a clear cursor.
Under the hood performance tweaks and LibVLC stability.
